title: USDA FSIS Food Safety Recall Record
description: Schema for USDA Food Safety and Inspection Service (FSIS) food product recall data, covering Class I through Class III recalls for meat, poultry, and processed food products.

recall_id.description: Unique identifier for the recall record (UUID v4)

recall_number.description: Official FSIS recall number in the format FSIS-YYYY-NNN

recall_date.description: Date the recall was announced or initiated

product_type.description: Category of the recalled food product

recall_class.description: FSIS recall class: Class I is life-threatening, Class II is remote adverse health consequence, Class III is unlikely to cause adverse health consequences

reason.description: Narrative description of the reason for the recall (e.g. undeclared allergen, potential Listeria contamination)

company_name.description: Name of the establishment or company initiating the recall

establishment_number.description: FSIS establishment grant number for the producing facility, if applicable

city.description: City where the recalling establishment is located

state.description: Two-letter US state abbreviation where the recalling establishment is located

pounds_recalled.description: Estimated pounds of product subject to the recall

distribution.description: Geographic scope of product distribution, e.g. Nationwide or Regional

status.description: Current status of the recall action

press_release_url.description: URL to the official FSIS press release for this recall

load_time.description: Timestamp when the record was loaded from the FSIS data source

_ingested_at.description: Timestamp when the record was ingested into the Fabric lakehouse

_batch_id.description: Batch run identifier for lineage and reprocessing traceability
